message: 初めてをあげちゃいます

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I want to... become your bride, President...」
Lolotte's warmth and softness as she snuggles gently against me.
Just from touching each other, my racing heart won't stop pounding.
Gazing firmly at Lolotte right in front of me--
An angelic sweetness drifts from her hair, spread out like feathers.
That alone is enough to make me lose my mind.

name: Synn
message: 「I want to kiss you too, Lolotte...」
Her faintly moistened eyes squeeze shut.
Drawing our lips together, we feel the person most precious to us closer than ever.
